$comment: Local Router declarative startup config. Chains are empty by default; pass this file at boot with `local-router start --config ./config/routes.example.json` (or LOCAL_ROUTER_ROUTES_CONFIG=/abs/path). Anything declared here REPLACES the persisted state for that section: fallbackModels replaces all local-router/<route> chains (validate against the full model inventory — serving-curated or not); curation replaces the serving selection; filterConfigured flips the Ollama-proxy key filter. Omit a section to leave the persisted state alone.
